profile.name: Julabo Magio MS-1000F 冷却恒温循环器
profile.description: Julabo Magio MS-1000F 是一款实验室用冷却/恒温循环器，通过循环温控液为外部设备或实验流程提供稳定的制冷与加热能力。它常用于仪器冷却、夹套反应器温控、样品环境温度控制以及其他需要精确循环温度管理的实验场景。
profile.description_en: The Julabo Magio MS-1000F is a laboratory recirculating chiller and temperature control unit that circulates thermal fluid to provide stable cooling and heating for external equipment or experimental processes. It is commonly used for instrument cooling, jacketed reactor temperature control, sample environment conditioning, and other applications requiring precise circulating temperature management.
